data.narrative:
Bedrock Ocean is a Series A-stage company in ocean and maritime technology founded by Anthony DiMare and Charles Chiau. The company has raised $63M to date. The comparable universe consists of two private peers operating in adjacent frontier-tech marine sectors: Seasats and Havoc AI. No public comparables exist in this nascent domain, limiting cross-market triangulation.

The stage-progression method is the primary applicable valuation approach given data constraints. Using total capital raised ($63M) as a proxy for current value and applying a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the next funding round, the method implies a valuation of $126M. This reflects the expected value accretion between Series A and Series B financing stages.

The triangulated valuation range is $107M (low), $126M (median), and $145M (high). The median of $126M represents the most defensible point estimate based on stage-progression methodology. Key uncertainties include the absence of public market benchmarks and a limited private comparable set, both of which constrain cross-validation of the implied multiple. The two-peer private comp universe provides insufficient statistical power for relative valuation anchoring. A more robust valuation would benefit from additional private comps or revenue/EBITDA metrics to stress-test the stage-progression assumption.
